links.outcome: Zero-shot multimodal LLM accuracy for binary intracranial hemorrhage detection on CT scans
links.effect: Overall accuracy 0.52; recall 0.14 for hemorrhage-positive cases, 0.87 for negative cases; exact match accuracy 0.06 for subtype classification.
links.quote: For binary detection, the model achieved an overall accuracy of 0.52, with low recall for hemorrhage-positive cases (0.14) and higher recall for hemorrhage-negative cases (0.87).

screen.reason: Evaluates zero-shot performance of a multimodal LLM on a benchmark dataset (PhysioNet) for CT intracranial hemorrhage detection and classification without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
